v1.4.5.description:
- Fixed a bug where items and checks weren't reliably saved to disk shortly after being received, because the save coroutine was never actually started.
- Fixed a crash that could silently lose recently received items and checks when a battle ended right as a save was queued.
- Fixed a bug where the Resplendent Bastion Gate item had no reconnect-time recovery if its flag failed to save, unlike most other items.
- Fixed several Act 2 sigil icon rendering bugs that showed up when sigil randomization mixed certain sigils onto the same card: oversized icons overlapping their neighbours, the activated ability button covering up whichever sigil landed in its spot, and conduit backgrounds (Healing Circuit, etc.) drawing on top of the other sigils.
- Fixed a bug where the Act 3 hammer could be saved as if it were one of your items, which left it in a normal item slot, pushed a real item into the hammer slot, and could then destroy that item when the next battle started.
- Fixed a bug where the player could become permanently unable to leave the game table in Act 3, if their Act 1 run had ended on the last node of the map.
- Made the Act 3 battery charging sequence behave more like vanilla, waiting for the charge to complete before you can move again, without the softlock the lockout used to risk for players who don't have the Inspectometer Battery yet.
- Made the Dredging Room mandatory again with `act3_overhaul`, but it now only unlocks once all 4 area bosses have been defeated.
- Fixed a bug with `act3_overhaul` where the holomap player marker could stay permanently hidden if you returned to the map before finishing the Dredging Room sequence.
- Fixed a bug with `act3_overhaul` where receiving the Inspectometer Battery before meeting the Scrybes could interrupt the charging sequence with an unrelated dredging room reminder.
- Removed the "CAN'T BE SACRIFICED." text that showed on filler check cards in Act 2.
- Fixed the Archipelago check card that replaces the tarot card below the cabin figurines: it's now gated behind zooming in like the vanilla card (so it no longer renders completely black), no longer swallows clicks meant for the box, and no longer clips through the shelf while held up.
- Reduced the lag spike the first time the pause menu is opened in Act 1 with `randomize_challenges` enabled.
- Fixed the "Respledent Bastion Gate" typo in the apworld.
- Fixed Act 1 area 2 logic checking an item name that doesn't exist, so its point never counted.
- Fixed the item pool being sized against the wrong location count, which could leave items unplaced on option combinations that drop locations.
- Traps are now rolled from the world's own random instead of the global one, so a seed reproduces its trap distribution.
- Added Universal Tracker support.

This release also includes a PopTracker pack for Inscryption Beta (`InscryptionTracker_v2.0.zip`). The old pack targeted the original `Inscryption` apworld and hadn't been updated since the beta branched, so this is a fresh 2.0 retargeted at the beta: all of the beta's locations and items, and options read from slot data on connect. To install it, move the zip into PopTracker's `packs` folder.

There are some known bugs with this release that I haven't gotten around to fixing, including:
- Check cards for filler items will sometimes appear as useful
- Detonator and Sentry have broken interactions with some Act 1 sigils that play cards in their spot when struck or killed (loose tail, bait bucket, etc.). also detonator broke when trying to hit the moon
- If you die in act 1, go to the deathcard sequence, save and reload act 1, you'll find yourself on the battle node you died to as if you beat it.
- And likely many others

Since this isn't on thunderstore as normal, you can install the mod like this:
- In r2modman, go to "Other" > "Settings"
- Scroll down to "Import local mod" and click on it
- Click "Select file" and navigate to the mod .zip

v1.5.0.description:
Requires a matching apworld -- older seeds will not work.

MAJOR CHANGES

- Filler items split per act instead of one shared pool; Act 1 currency survives death
- Any single act can be reset from the Archipelago options menu
- Card packs open next to the rulebook, not at the table. Act 3 Overhaul lets you stand up at any time
- Run state recovery after a force quit or act exit redone: both saves reload from disk and every item sent is replayed. Fixes abandoned battles marking their node beaten, items lost to them, and duplicates on reconnect
- New `releaseOnActCompletion` setting, included in logic

MINOR CHANGES / BUGFIXES

- A consumable check you already took is no longer offered again later in the same node
- The dagger and angler hook reach the run they were sent to instead of the next one
- The oil painting no longer asks for a side deck card you can no longer draw
- Room settings are remembered across connections, in `Archipelago_Inscryption.cfg` (password in plain text)
- Fewer connection failures when joining a large room
- Logic changes: Quill, Mycologists, All Totem Battles, grizzly bosses, wetlands, later woodlands
- Item recovery reworked; every item must declare how it is recovered. Fixes vessel/conduit upgrades and Ourobot lost to an Act 3 reset, Skink and Ant cards lost to a new run, and the bee figurine from a second Progressive Squirrel
- Finding a card gives you that card. The Stinkbug, Stunted Wolf, Fishbot, Lonely Wizbot and Ourobot can appear in choices, packs and the trader, one per deck
- Cards an uncollected check pays for are no longer handed out early
- Fixes: Act 1 mid-battle saves skipping the node, pack rat plus magpie bottle softlock, duplicate items on connect, currency leaking across acts, Act 2 pushing you into Act 3, item log and DeathLink shared between saves, crash while building a new save
- Reset Save Data clears that save's Archipelago data and returns to the Archipelago menu
v1.5.0.title: Inscryption Beta v1.5.0

v1.5.1.description:
Two logic fixes, both in the apworld and tracker. The mod itself is unchanged and its version moves only to stay in step. Item and location ids are unchanged, so 1.5.1 and 1.5.0 pair correctly either way, but seeds generated before this may have progression placed as though the locations below were reachable early -- regenerate if you want the corrected logic.

- Fixed the four Act 3 Luke file rooms not requiring the Quill. Each room's file node carries `ActiveIfStoryFlag(FileAccessGiven)`, and the only thing that sets that flag is the Archivist's file-browse sequence, which needs the Quill. A previous release dropped the requirement after confirming nothing in `HoloMapLukeFile` reads the Quill flag -- true, but the wrong place to look, since the gate is on the prefab and not in code.
- Fixed beating Act 2 not requiring the Act 2 Bridge Repair item when the bridge is randomized. Two Scrybes sit across the bridge whichever side the run starts on, but the act's beat rule asked only for the epitaphs, camera, meat and monocle, which let sequential act unlocks reach Act 3 without the bridge item.
- Every individual location was gated correctly in both cases, which is why neither surfaced earlier. The tracker gained a checker that compares each location's whole access expression against the apworld's, rather than only the named rules inside it -- the gap that let both through.
v1.5.1.title: Inscryption Beta v1.5.1

v1.5.2.description:
Mod-side fixes. No logic, item or location changed, so a 1.5.1 seed pairs with this mod either way and there's no reason to regenerate. The apworld and tracker ship 1.5.2 with no changes of their own.

- Fixed a bug where the Next button on the save name screen did nothing, so no new save could be created. Checking the name for illegal characters called a string method that's missing from the runtime some installs load (r2modman's BepInEx among them), and the exception it threw every frame is what left the button dead.
- The mod now builds against the BepInEx pinned in `manifest.json` and against the game's own runtime assemblies instead of the SDK's reference pack, so an API the shipped game doesn't have can't make it into a release again. `tools/fetch-dependencies.sh` populates `Dependencies/` from a game install; see the new Building from source section in the README.
- Fixed a bug where resetting the save file left Act 1 with an oversized deck. The reset deals a run before the mod is back in touch with the server, so every card item the server then resent was added on top of a deck that already had them. Entering Act 1 now deals that run again.
- Fixed a bug where a pile of items could land on an act you'd already started playing. Items still waiting to be announced are now applied before the verify pass rather than alongside it, and the connect screen waits for all of them instead of only the one on screen.
- Fixed a bug where leaving an act through the mod's own exit replayed that act's release, duplicating its filler checks. That exit saves on its way out, so there's nothing to revert.
- Fixed a bug where reconnecting handed out a second copy of a counted item -- currency, packs, pelts, upgrades, challenges and traps -- that was never missing.
v1.5.2.title: Inscryption Beta v1.5.2

v1.5.3.description:
Mod fixes and tracker map fixes. The apworld is a version bump only, so a 1.5.2 seed pairs with
this mod as before.

- Ourobot, the Fishbot or the Lonely Wizbot sent during Act 2 no longer rewrites your Act 3 sigils
- An activated sigil no longer locks an Act 3 battle when Act 3 is played before Act 2
- Tracker: the three Act 3 shortcut markers and the satellite dish sit on the rooms their checks come from
- Tracker: the three Vessel Upgrades show in all four Act 3 boss rooms
- Tracker: item grids shrink to 48px, so the act columns fit a shorter window
- Tracker: the Lonely Wizbot, Fishbot and Ourobot icons are cropped to the card art
v1.5.3.title: Inscryption Beta v1.5.3

v1.5.4.description:
Mod-side fixes. The apworld and tracker ship 1.5.4 with no changes of their own, so a
1.5.3 seed pairs with this mod exactly as before.

- DeathLink waits out transitions and special node sequences before deciding what a death means
- Several deaths landing during one wait are banked and spent together, instead of only the first
- Deaths that arrive with no act on screen are ignored, and anything pending is voided when the act changes
- A death discarded that way is silent to the player and only reaches the plugin log
- Progressive Candle counts copies instead of reading the run's lives, which dealt three candles from one copy after a save file reset
